### First Solar to Inaugurate First Phase of South Carolina Production Facility


October 27, 2026


GAFFNEY, S.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


First Solar, Inc. (Nasdaq: FSLR) ("First Solar" or "the Company") will inaugurate the first phase of its new facility in Gaffney, Cherokee County, South Carolina, on Wednesday, October 28, 2026.


South Carolina Governor Henry McMaster, US Senator Darline Graham, US Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick, State Senator Harvey Peeler, State Representatives Dennis Moss and Brian Lawson, and Gaffney Mayor Lyman D. Dawkins III are expected to join First Solar Chief Executive Officer Mark Widmar, employees, and community leaders for the ceremony.


The approximately $330 million facility onshores final production processes for the Company’s Series 6 *Plus* modules and currently employs approximately 500 people, a number that is forecast to rise to nearly 700 by mid-2027, when the facility’s second phase is expected to be completed.


The ceremony will be live streamed on First Solar’s X account beginning at 1 pm ET at[https://go.firstsolar.com/firstsolar_southcarolina](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fgo.firstsolar.com%2Ffirstsolar_southcarolina&esheet=54629926&newsitemid=20261027073789&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fgo.firstsolar.com%2Ffirstsolar_southcarolina&index=1&md5=2c77ff81186bcf2bb4044d60f87002ae) .


**About First Solar, Inc.**


First Solar, Inc. is America's leading PV solar technology and manufacturing company. The only US-headquartered company among the world's largest solar manufacturers, First Solar is focused on competitively and reliably enabling power generation needs with its advanced, uniquely American thin film PV technology. Developed at research and development (R&D) labs in California and Ohio, the Company's technology provides a competitive, high-performance, and responsibly produced alternative to conventional crystalline silicon PV modules. For more information, please visit[www.firstsolar.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.firstsolar.com&esheet=54629926&newsitemid=20261027073789&lan=en-US&anchor=www.firstsolar.com&index=2&md5=429ebd2a2c4f7bc1ccbe10fe50313554) .
